Stop.command: [ -x ./bin/tkg-hooks ] && ./bin/tkg-hooks record-handoff || which tkg-hooks >/dev/null 2>&1 && tkg-hooks record-handoff || true

SessionStart.command: [ -x ./bin/tkg-hooks ] && ./bin/tkg-hooks inject-wake || which tkg-hooks >/dev/null 2>&1 && tkg-hooks inject-wake || true

PreInvocation.command: [ -x ./bin/tkg-hooks ] && ./bin/tkg-hooks detect-wip || which tkg-hooks >/dev/null 2>&1 && tkg-hooks detect-wip || true

hooks.command: [ -x ./bin/tkg-hooks ] && ./bin/tkg-hooks pre-tool-use || which tkg-hooks >/dev/null 2>&1 && tkg-hooks pre-tool-use || true
